new: Sound by mode: pages stay silent until Sound is pressed; a headset starts with the sound effects on and the narration off.
In a headset the story panel's Sound button turns the narration on, and it stays on in the next session.
Shared rooms: Narration On for all and Off for all (the menu's Circles tab, the Shared dialog); a headset's own press holds until the lobby.
Getting around: a welcome panel once a session in a headset, after lining up: how to go into the circles, and what the trigger, grip and a stick's click do.
After standby: no Leave AR message; the headset looks for its spots by itself, and the check by eye still asks.
Camera mode: an Android phone in AR, lined up on spot A and spot B, follows a person or a circle for filming.
Studio: trigger cubes can change a model's texture while you stand inside them.
Studio: moving items show their ghost while editing, and an object's cut-outs can be locked.
Fixes: Real world hides can be turned on again in a session that began with it off; controller clicks work at once after a sleep.
test: Quest, VR and AR: effects on and narration off at the start; the story panel's Sound button turns the narration on; still on next session.
Two headsets in a room: On for all and Off for all; then one headset's own press, and the lobby giving the room's choice back.
The welcome after lining up: its words for walking in and for asking first; it closes after 14 s or when the menu opens; with hands, the pinch's words.
A headset asleep for a few minutes in a room: no Leave AR message, the check by eye asks, the circles still line up.
After a sleep: the trigger clicks at once, without opening the Quest menu first.
Real world hides set to nothing, then AR, then turned on again: people and the room hide the scene.
Camera mode on an Android phone: line up on the two spots, follow a person and a circle, film it with the screen recorder.
Studio: a cube that changes a texture while you stand in it; ghosts while editing; locked cut-outs that do not move.
untested: Everything in a headset and on a phone: this release was checked only in headless Chromium.
